name: Responsive Admin Viewports Preview
author: Adnan Shahid

sections.description:
Responsive preview tool for WordPress admin to switch between mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports inside the dashboard.

Key features
* One-click viewport buttons (Mobile / Tablet / Desktop)
* Uses an iframe to preview your site inside the WordPress admin
* No tracking, no external requests, no background processes

License

GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Open Responsive Preview from the WordPress admin menu
  4. Use the buttons to switch viewports
sections.faq:
Does this plugin scan or secure my website?

No. This plugin only provides a responsive preview and does not perform security scanning, fixes, or monitoring.

Does this plugin change my site content?

No. It only displays your site in an iframe for preview purposes.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes. It previews your site as rendered by your active theme.
